levels.name: Power Grid

startScreen.title: Power Grid
startScreen.subtitle: Bring an abandoned generator hall back online. Carry the power cell to its socket, activate two coolant consoles and open the emergency exit. Visual landmark: Power lattice.
startScreen.howToPlay: WASD move · Mouse look · F pick up / interact · Esc pause. Carry the amber Power Cell to the generator. Activate both cyan coolant consoles. The green exit opens when power and coolant are restored.
startScreen.controlsHint: F carry / interact • Cell → generator → two coolant consoles
startScreen.credits: Original models, textures and sound by Digital Opus. A pre-release engine example.

ui.winMessage: The facility hums back to life.
ui.loseMessage: Return to the arrival point and choose a new route.
